name: Ganaxolone
metabolism: Metabolism involves several CYPs, including CYP3A4/5, CYP2B6, CYP2C19 and CYP2D6, together with multiple UGT enzymes. Elimination is mainly fecal and urinary as metabolites.
summary: Ganaxolone is a neuroactive steroid that positively modulates GABA-A receptors. It is used to treat seizures in people with cyclin-dependent kinase-like 5 (CDKL5) deficiency disorder.
